title: Senior Process Engieer
description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

title: New Business Account Executive (DACH market)
description:
About The Role

Vivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.
We are expanding our institutional footprint in Germany.
We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers.
If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Originate Institutional Pipeline: Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates.
  • Leverage Channel Partnerships: Build strategic relationships with local multipliers—accountants, tax advisors, law firms—who manage hundreds of entities requiring modern treasury setups.
  • Navigate Complex Sales Cycles: Run the end-to-end commercial cycle for high-value accounts, from sophisticated discovery and structured treasury pitches to compliance onboarding and closing.
  • Position Vivid as a Yield Partner: Educate fund managers and corporate treasurers on how to leverage Vivid’s Treasury and MMF solutions to optimize returns on their cash reserves and dry powder.
  • Shape the German Playbook: Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market.
  • Represent the Brand: Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management).
  • Deep local knowledge: You thoroughly understand Germanys financial structures (Soparfis, RAIFs, SICAVs) and know how these entities manage liquidity and banking relationships.
  • An established network: You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents.
  • Technical fluency: You can speak confidently about FX, money market funds, yield generation, and compliance/KYB processes for complex corporate structures.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English and German is required. 


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. 
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.

title: (Senior) Business Development Manager DACH (m/f/d)
description:
THE JOB

Warum mute-labs?

Bei mute-labs gibt es weder „VC-getriebenen Burnout“ noch toxische Sales Floors. Wir sind ein eigenfinanziertes, nachhaltig profitables Team mit einer klaren Mission: mehr Ruhe in die lautesten Büros der Welt zu bringen.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikboxen, die wirklich zu modernen Arbeitswelten passen.

Dabei verkaufen wir nicht einfach nur „Boxen“ – wir verkaufen Fokus, Produktivität und ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld.

Für den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Full-Cycle BDR, der den gesamten Sales-Prozess selbst in die Hand nehmen möchte – vom ersten „Hallo“ bis zum finalen Handshake.

Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren

Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.

  • Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
  • Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
  • Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen

Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur. Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.

  • 09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
  • 09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
  • 11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
  • 12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
  • 14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
  • 18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday

Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.

  • The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
  • The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Schnell & transparent

Wir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir Dich nicht wochenlang warten.

  1. The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia, um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
  2. The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
  3. The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
  4. The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.
  5. The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO, in dem es um das große Ganze und Deine Entwicklung bei mute-labs geht.
Erkennst Du Dich wieder?
  • Self-Driven Hunter: Du brauchst keinen Provisionscheck, um ambitioniert zu bleiben. Du willst Deine Ziele erreichen und das Unternehmen aktiv mit voranbringen.
  • Native Communicator: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst Dich sicher und überzeugend im DACH-Markt bewegen.
  • Full-Cycle Mindset: Du magst sowohl den Reiz, neue Leads zu finden, als auch das gute Gefühl, einen Deal selbst zum Abschluss zu bringen.
  • Team Player: Arbeiten in Silos ist nichts für Dich. Du möchtest Erfolge teilen, voneinander lernen und Deine Kolleg:innen genauso bei ihren Deals unterstützen wie bei Deinen eigenen.
Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen?

Wenn Du nach einer Sales-Rolle suchst, in der Du als Profi behandelt wirst, von einem starken Team unterstützt wirst und in einer offenen, ambitionierten Office-Kultur arbeiten möchtest, dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir melden uns schneller bei Dir, als Du denkst!


ABOUT US

Here at mute-labs, we aim to enable companies to achieve more by democratizing silence in the workspace. And we’re not like any other Berlin startup you might know: 

  • We’re “no tech”: We know how to develop and sell great hardware products with a focus on sound-insulated phone- and meeting booths.

title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Your Profile

  • Community & Networking: Participate in our various networking events, tech talks, and business talks.
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offerings.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

title: Principal Software Developer (f/m/d) - Market Data
description:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!


Job Overview

Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices. 

Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team.   

You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you!


Your Tasks

  • Designing and implementing challenging projects to develop our data processing pipeline.
  • Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run.
  • Engineering ETL processes.
  • Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors.
  • Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data.


Your Profile

  • 8+ years of software development, data engineering, or relevant experience, including at least 5 years of in-depth Python experience.
  • Software Engineering: good understanding of microservice architectures, Liskov’s Substitution Principle, design patterns, and dynamic dispatch.
  • Databases: experience with at least one SQL/NoSQL database, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including schema definition and evolution, as well as ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy, JPA, or Hibernate.
  • Cloud / Cloud-native development: Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • CI/CD: ability to define build pipelines and perform, validate, and monitor deployments.
  • Good understanding of microservice architectures.
  • Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology.
  • Git: ability to use Git from the command line and apply version-control management practices (e.g., Gitflow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong technical mentoring skills.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Communication: ability to illustrate ideas and concepts with figurative examples to both stakeholders and developers.
  • Ability to perceive the business domain in terms of mathematical structures is appreciated.


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting.

  • Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy.

title: Dealer Account Manager
description:
About AIM Intelligent Machines

AIM Intelligent Machines is pioneering the future of heavy equipment automation. Our technology enables a single operator to monitor and control multiple machines simultaneously—dramatically improving productivity, reducing labor costs, and reshaping what's possible in construction, mining, and industrial operations.

Through cutting-edge AI, computer vision, and robotics, AIM is solving critical challenges in equipment autonomy and remote operations. We're building systems that augment human capability—allowing people to do more with less, safely and efficiently.

We are growing quickly and looking for experienced, motivated Account Managers to accelerate adoption of our solutions by building strong partnerships and cultivating strategic customer relationships.

 

Position Summary

As Dealer Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in scaling AIM’s groundbreaking heavy equipment automation platform. You’ll be responsible for growing revenue through both channel partners and direct key accounts, with a clear focus on companies looking to deploy machine automation that allows one operator to manage fleets of equipment.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams—including sales leadership, product, and engineering—to help customers modernize their operations and gain a competitive edge through AIM’s autonomous systems.

 

Key Responsibilities

Channel Partner Management

  • Build and grow relationships with channel partners (resellers, OEMs, system integrators) to drive adoption of AIM’s automation platform.

  • Enable and train partners to sell AIM solutions focused on multi-machine control and operator augmentation.

  • Monitor partner performance and support business planning to meet joint sales targets.

  • Identify new partners in strategic markets (construction, mining, landfill and quarry environments.

 

Key Account Management

  • Identify and engage high-potential enterprise accounts seeking to modernize heavy equipment operations through automation, specifically in the mining, landfill and quarry markets.

  • Understand customer workflows and pain points, and position AIM’s multi-machine control solutions as a strategic advantage.

  • Lead the sales process from discovery through close, with support from technical teams.

  • Maintain strong post-sale relationships to drive expansion and long-term success.

 

Internal Collaboration

  • Work with marketing to create partner- and industry-specific messaging and campaigns.

  • Partner with product teams to communicate market feedback and help shape feature development

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, and performance metrics.

 

Qualifications & Skills

  • 3–7 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or channel sales—preferably in earthworks tech, industrial ground engagement automation, and heavy machinery.

  • Experience selling or supporting technology that transforms field operations or operator workflows.

  • Strong understanding of the construction or mining ecosystem—including OEMs, contractors, equipment dealers, and tech providers.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Self-starter with the ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly innovative environment.

  • Comfortable with travel (30–50%) to partner/customer sites and industry events.

 

Why Join AIM?

  • Solve a massive set of real-world problems that require scalable earth moving

  • Accomplish that via deploying and expanding cutting edge tech

  • Run your workstreams with the largest degree of autonomy

  • Have an opportunity for rapid growth and a large voice on the direction of the company

  • Receive company funded medical, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance, gourmet food & perks

  • Experience a strong onsite collaboration (AIM offices, labs and proving grounds on the east side of the Greater Seattle area)

  • Have an opportunity to travel to unique sites around the world (Americas, Australia, Africa & more)

 

Compensation: $115K – $160K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

description:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. Your Role

As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical ChallengeYour team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.


Your Mission

  • Lead and long-term grow a team of AI engineers, providing both strategical technical direction and people leadership
  • Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Set the bar for accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of our AI features through rigorous testing practices
  • Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
  • Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the team
  • Coach and develop your team members, supporting their technical and professional growth
  • Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the team


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering and at least 1+ years in a leading position, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
  • EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
  • Fair, competitive compensation.

title: Working Student – IT Support & Systems

Your mission

planqc builds neutral atom quantum computers in Garching. Behind every experiment and every line of control software sits an IT setup that has to work: laptops that are ready on day one, accounts that exist when someone starts, and hardware that is where it should be.
As a Working Student in IT Support & Systems, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues who need IT help. You handle 1st level support, prepare and hand over equipment, and keep our Microsoft 365 environment and IT documentation in order. You also support onboarding and offboarding from the IT side, so new colleagues can start working immediately.
This role suits a student who wants real hands on experience with infrastructure and admin tools, and who enjoys helping people as much as fixing systems.


Your responsibilities

  • Provide 1st level IT support for employees and troubleshoot common hardware, software and access issues
  • Support hardware procurement: ordering, tracking and preparing laptops, monitors and accessories
  • Manage the equipment lifecycle, from setup for new starters to collection and reset for leavers
  • Support IT onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, access, devices and the welcome setup
  • Handle day to day Microsoft 365 tasks such as mailboxes, distribution lists and Teams/SharePoint access
  • Keep IT documentation accurate and up to date, including guides, inventory lists and onboarding checklists
  • Work with your IT colleagues on more complex issues and escalate when needed


What you bring

  • Enrolled in an IT related degree program such as Computer Science or Information Systems, any semester
  • Genuine interest in IT and in how systems and infrastructure work
  • Basic computer literacy with Windows or macOS and solid troubleshooting instincts
  • Ability to pick up new tools quickly and to ask questions when something is unclear
  • Reliable and organized, with clear communication towards colleagues without an IT background


Nice to have

  • Hobby level experience with Windows or macOS troubleshooting, home networking or similar
  • Basic familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools such as Outlook, SharePoint and Teams
  • Interest in growing into a junior or full System Administrator role over time


What characterizes you

  • You are curious and eager to learn. You do not need to know everything on day one
  • You are friendly and patient when helping colleagues who are less confident with technology
  • You are detail oriented, especially with equipment tracking and onboarding steps
  • You take ownership of small tasks and follow through


Why join planqc

At planqc, you will work on one of the most promising quantum computing architectures alongside a highly driven and collaborative team spanning physics, engineering, and software.
We combine deep-tech research with an engineering mindset, turning scientific breakthroughs into scalable quantum systems.
Joining us means:

  • Working on cutting-edge neutral atom quantum hardware
  • Collaborating with an exceptional, international team across disciplines
  • Contributing to a fast-growing quantum startup at a pivotal stage
 
Benefits at planqc
  • Flexible working. Flexible hours and hybrid work where the role allows.

  • Learning and development. Trainings and conference participation, including international conferences. Plus regular internal learning sessions where colleagues share their knowledge.
  • Four locations. Headquarters in Garching, an office in central Munich, plus sites in Ulm and Innsbruck.
  • Team culture. Regular team and company events throughout the year, from after work socials to our summer and Christmas parties.
If you're excited about keeping the people and systems of a quantum computing company running while you study, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.


Deine Aufgaben

title: Diesel Mechanic
description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

We are currently seeking a skilled Diesel Mechanic to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting diesel engines and related systems on our autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

 

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine maintenance tasks on diesel engines, including oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks, to ensure proper functioning and longevity.

  • Diagnose and repair diesel engine malfunctions, mechanical issues, and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, and troubleshooting techniques.

  • Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern.

  • Overhaul and rebuild diesel engines and associated systems, including fuel injection systems, turbochargers, and exhaust systems, as needed to restore performance and efficiency.

  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements.

  • Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids.

  • Collaborate with other maintenance technicians, engineers, and operators to troubleshoot complex problems, share technical knowledge, and implement effective solutions.

 

Qualifications

  • Marine Diesel and/or Volvo VODIA experience required

  • GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.

  • Proven experience as a diesel technician or a diesel mechanic, with demonstrated proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining diesel engines and related systems.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics.

  • Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment used in diesel engine repair, such as scan tools, multimeters, and oscilloscopes.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical issues.

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

  • Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines.

  • Ability to travel as needed to meet business objectives, including throughout the Indo-Pacific region and to our headquarters in Austin, Texas. This role will require spending 30+ days training at Saronic headquarters in Austin, Texas.

 

Physical Demands

  • Ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods.

  • Frequently and repetitively lift, push, and carry up to 23 kg's.

  • Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in marine and waterside environments.

  • Frequently and repetitively bend, lift, and reach to install and remove components of varying size and weight.

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including over varied and uneven terrain such as docks, vessel decks, and gravel surfaces.

  • Stoop, lay, bend, reach, squat, kneel, crouch, twist, and crawl for extended periods while working in confined or low-clearance spaces.

title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA, Supacat, and Galvion, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.

THE ROLE

The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.

Your core responsibilities include:

  • Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.

  • Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.

  • Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.

You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.

  • You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.

  • New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

  • A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

What we're looking for:

  • A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.

  • At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.

  • Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.

  • Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.

  • You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.

  • Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial.

  • Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then.

It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level.

You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English.

DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED?

title: Mixed-Signal IC Design Engineer
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

As Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification.

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

  • Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology.

  • Experience building verification environments and developing tests, assertions, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts.

  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the mixed-signal verification methodology and verification plan for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago SoCs.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Work closely with analog, RTL, architecture, firmware, and SoC verification teams to identify and resolve interface issues.

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

About you

You’ll fit in well if

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

  • A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min)
